# ELS Agent Practices

> Best practices for working with AI agents in empirical legal research, and a starter instruction file (CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md) for empirical legal studies projects. Published versions are numbered and never change; the draft changes often.

- [Starter instruction file for an ELS project (save as CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md)](latest/starter-CLAUDE.md)
- [Full guide, latest published version](latest/agent-best-practices.md)
- [All published versions](versions.json)
- [Working draft](draft/agent-best-practices.md)
